defs.def: to choose sb/sth from a group of people or things 选择；挑选

ex.s: Pick out diseased plants in the forestB.
ex.t: 从森林中挑选出患病植物。

ex.s: Pick it up at the lending library.
ex.t: 我们可能永远无法知道它是否真实。

ex.s: From then on, if I wanted to read an ending guaranteed to be happy, I’d pick up a love romance.
ex.t: 从那以后，如果我想读一个保证美满的结局，我就会拿起一本爱情浪漫小说。

ex.s: The first book I picked up was Montaigne's Essays.
ex.t: 我拿起的第一本书是蒙田的《随笔集》。

ex.s: She ceased her struggle the instant I picked her up.
ex.t: 我一把她抱起来，她就停止了挣扎。

ex.s: Picking outB.
ex.t: 挑选出 B.

ex.s: Pick the most important.
ex.t: 选择最重要的。

ex.s: It picks up delicate objects in different ways.
ex.t: 它以不同的方式拾取精致的物体。

ex.s: “Some nights my heart was breaking to have to pick between my kids and studying for exams or papers,” she says.
ex.t: "有些晚上要在孩子和学习考试或论文之间做选择我的心都要碎了，"她说。

ex.s: Why does Jeff have to pick a team to support？
ex.t: 为什么Jeff必须选择支持一支队伍？

ex.s: Retired Workers Can Pick Up New Skills
ex.t: 退休工人可以掌握新技能

ex.s: Here she picks her top reads.
ex.t: 这里是她挑选的最爱读物。

ex.s: Picking up her“Lifetime Achievement”award，proud Irene   64  （declare） she had no plans   65   （retire） from her 36-year-old business.
ex.t: 捧起她的"终身成就奖"，自豪的艾琳宣布她没有退休的计划，不想离开她经营了36年的企业。

ex.s: Pick, at random, Busuu in Cameroon (eight remaining speakers), Chiapaneco in Mexico(150).
ex.t: 随机挑选喀麦隆的布斯语（仅剩8名使用者）、墨西哥的奇帕内科语（150人）。

ex.s: It was a big deal for us to load up and go to the local library, where my kids could pick out books to read or books they wanted me to read to them.
ex.t: 对我们来说，装满东西去当地图书馆是件大事，孩子们可以在那里挑选自己读的书，或挑出想让我读给他们听的书。

ex.s: Items are picked up at one of our libraries — the one you selected in the ILL Request Form.
ex.t: 物品在我们的一家图书馆取——即你在馆际互借申请表上选择的那家。

ex.s: Don’t forget to stop by Pacific Science Center’s Store while you are here to pick up a wonderful science activity or remember your visit.
ex.t: 在此期间，别忘了顺道去太平洋科学中心的商店，挑选一项精彩的科学活动或纪念品来纪念你的参观。

ex.s: The researchers found that the dogs were able to pick the angry or happy face by touching a picture of it with their noses more often than one would expect by random chance.
ex.t: 研究人员发现，狗能够通过用鼻子触碰图片来选择愤怒或快乐的面孔，其正确率高于随机概率。

ex.s: That said, to be honest the only people who ever ring our home phone are our Baby Boomers parents, to the point where we play a game and guess who is calling before we pick up the phone （using Caller ID would take the fun out of it）.
ex.t: 也就是说，老实说，唯一会给我们家座机打电话的人是我们婴儿潮一代的父母，以至于我们会玩个游戏，在接电话前猜是谁打来的（用来电显示会破坏这种乐趣）。

defs.def: to take flowers, fruit, etc. from the plant or the tree where they are growing 采；摘

ex.s: Once the book you've requested is delivered to the nearest branch, they will inform you by e-mail, so you can pick it up.
ex.t: 一旦你借的书送到最近的分馆，他们会通过电子邮件通知你，这样你就可以去取了。

ex.s: Instead of walking a few blocks to pick up a child or the dry cleaning, they send the self-driving minibus.
ex.t: 他们不是步行几个街区去接孩子或取干洗的衣服，而是派出自动驾驶小巴。

ex.s: When summer came, they will invite their students pick the vegetables!
ex.t: 夏天来了的时候，他们会邀请学生来摘蔬菜！

ex.s: When summer came, they will invite their students pick the vegetables！
ex.t: 夏天到来时，他们会邀请学生来摘蔬菜！

ex.s: （1分）Let's not pick these peaches until this weekend                   they get sweet enough to be eaten．（  ）
ex.t: 4．（1分）咱们等到这个周末再摘这些桃子吧，____它们足够甜可以吃了。（ ）

ex.s: We started from Vancouver, where we picked up our vehicle for the trip - a home on wheels.
ex.t: 我们从温哥华出发, 在那里我们拿起我们的车辆 旅行 - 一个车轮上的家。

defs.def: to pull or remove sth or small pieces of sth from sth else, especially with your fingers （用手指）摘掉，剔除，掐去

ex.s: So, don’t forget to pick up some chicken on your way home and try this recipe out!
ex.t: 所以，别忘了在回家的路上买些鸡肉，试试这个食谱！

defs.def: to choose a horse, etc. that you think is most likely to win a race 认定胜利者（如赛马中）

ex.s: The invitation is clear: Weiner wants you to pick up a coffee or tea and sit down with this book.
ex.t: 邀请函很明确： Weiner希望您拿起一杯咖啡或茶，坐下来阅读这本书。

ex.s: Do you need me to pick you up?
ex.t: 你需要我来接你吗？

defs.def: to make a very good choice 挑选得当；选得很准
to eat food slowly, taking small amounts or bites because you are not hungry 磨蹭着吃；（因为不饿而）小口吃

ex.s: 39     On our first morning in Paris, I went around the corner to the food market to pick up some groceries.
ex.t: 39    在巴黎的第一个早晨，我拐过街角去食品市场买了些食品杂货。

defs.def: to pull or touch sth several times （反复地）揪，扯
to treat sb unfairly, by blaming, criticizing or punishing them （跟某人）闹别扭；故意刁难挑剔
to choose sb/sth 挑选；选中
to choose sb/sth carefully from a group of people or things 精心挑选
to recognize sb/sth from among other people or things 认出来；辨别出
to play a tune on a musical instrument slowly without using written music （不用乐谱）慢慢地弹奏（乐曲）
to discover or recognize sth after careful study （经仔细研究）找出，认识到

ex.s: However, what my children want to do after school is pick up a screen — any screen — and stare at it for hours.
ex.t: 然而，我的孩子们放学后想做的，是拿起一块屏幕——任何屏幕——然后盯着它看上几个小时。

defs.def: to make sth easy to see or hear 使显著；使容易看见（或听见）
to get better, stronger, etc; to improve 改善；好转；增强
to start again; to continue 重新开始；继续

ex.s: The good news is that when that happens, we pick ourselves up, brush ourselves off, and get back to work.
ex.t: 好消息是，当失败发生时，我们会重新站起来，拍掉身上的灰尘，继续工作。

defs.def: to put things away and make things neat, especially for sb else （为某人）收拾，整理
to go somewhere in your car and collect sb who is waiting for you （开车）接人

ex.s: Uncle Paul, my dad’s friend, picked us up from the airport and drove us up to his farm in Pecos.
ex.t: 爸爸的朋友保罗叔叔从机场接上我们，开车送我们到了他在佩科斯的农场。

defs.def: to allow sb to get into your vehicle and take them somewhere 让人乘车；搭载
to rescue sb from the sea or from a dangerous place, especially one that is difficult to reach （从海里或危险处）营救，搭救
to start talking to sb you do not know because you want to have a sexual relationship with them （猥亵地与生人）搭讪，勾搭
to arrest sb 警察
to make sb feel better 使人觉得舒服；提神
to get information or a skill by chance rather than by making a deliberate effort （偶然）得到，听到，学会

ex.s: Picking up a new habit takes a few week, while building a healthy habit takes a shorter time.
ex.t: 学会一个新习惯只需要几周，而养成健康习惯需要更短的时间。

ex.s: the skill she picked up in Wisconsin
ex.t: 她在威斯康星学到的技能。

defs.def: to identify or recognize sth 辨认；识别出
to collect sth from a place 取回；收集
to receive an electronic signal, sound or picture 接收（信号、声音、图像等）
to buy sth, especially cheaply or by chance （碰巧）买到（便宜的东西）

ex.s: It is the story of an American travelling to a strange land, and of the people he meets on his way: Rustam, his translator, a lovely 24-year-old who picked up his colorful English in California, Oleg and Natasha, his hosts in Tashkent, and a string of foreign aid workers.
ex.t: 这是一位美国人旅行到一个陌生的地方的故事,还有他在路上遇到的人:鲁斯塔姆,他的翻译家,一个可爱的24岁少年,在加利福尼亚,奥列格和娜塔莎,他的东道主塔什干,以及一串外援工人.

ex.s: In addition, I have an old two-volume copy of the Shorter Oxford Dictionary, picked up a few years ago in a bookshop sale for just 99 pence.
ex.t: 此外，我有一套旧的《简明牛津词典》上下两册，是几年前在书店特卖时只花99便士买到的。

ex.s: Fearing that I would pick out something awful, I desperately tried to ask the boy ahead of me for a recommendation.
ex.t: 担心会挑到难吃的东西，我拼命想请前面的男孩推荐一下。

defs.def: to get or obtain sth 得；感染；得到
to find and follow a route 找到；跟踪；追寻
to return to an earlier subject or situation in order to continue it 回到（本题）；恢复原状
to notice sth that is not very obvious; to see sth that you are looking for 察觉；发现；注意到

ex.s: Should you come across waste paper thrown out of a passing car, pick it up.
ex.t: 如果你看到从经过的汽车里扔出的废纸，请把它捡起来。

ex.s: The elephant was found to either use suction at a fixed distance from the pancake to "raise” the object in the air and hold it, or gently press the tip of its trunk against the pancake and apply suction to pick it up.
ex.t: 研究发现，大象要么在离煎饼固定距离处使用吸力把物体抬到空中并吸住，要么轻轻把象鼻尖压在煎饼上施加吸力把它捡起。

defs.def: to put things away neatly 收拾；整理
to put things away and make a room neat 收拾房间
to notice sth and perhaps react to it 领略；意会；意识到
to return to a point that has already been mentioned or discussed 回到（某课题等）；重提（要点等）

ex.s: The problem of robocalls has gotten so bad that many people now refuse to pick up calls from numbers they don't know.
ex.t: 骚扰电话的问题已经如此严重，以至于现在许多人拒绝接听来自陌生号码的电话。

defs.def: an act of choosing sth 挑选；选择
a person or thing that is chosen 选中的人（或物）

ex.s: She suspected that one of her three daughters —then ten, eight, and six— had picked it up, but the girls said they hadn't.
ex.t: 她怀疑是她的三个女儿中的一个——当时十岁、八岁和六岁——拿走了它，但女孩们说她们没有。

defs.def: the best thing or things in a group 精品；精华；最好的东西

ex.s: Presenting the best of the West End along with the pick of the UK’s touring shows, the New Theatre is Cardiff’s oldest surviving traditional theatre.
ex.t: 呈现西区最佳剧目以及英国巡演精选，New Theatre是卡迪夫现存最古老的传统剧院。

defs.def: 镐与平锹

ex.s: I was trying to pick it up when it bit me again.
ex.t: 我正想把它捡起来，它又咬了我一口。
